cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Choose the Relationship
cards.instruction: Make someone prioritize this connection over a competing person, promise, or opportunity.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've set your place at home tonight. I finally learned your mother's dumplings; the networking dinner can proceed without you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The director's coming. I could get promoted.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your promotion campaign may resume tomorrow. Tonight I want you choosing us, not collecting a hot plate between appointments.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll freeze them. We can eat together tomorrow.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That postponement isn't approved. You used it on our anniversary. Call the dinner organizer and say you already have a commitment with me.

reason: A treats the career opportunity and meal postponement as requests subject to A timetable, insisting the relationship displace the competing event.
